description: This file contains the definition of the S3EncryptionClient class, which provides a wrapper around the AWS S3 client to handle encryption and decryption of data during upload and retrieval operations. It includes methods for asynchronous and synchronous put/get object operations with integrated encryption workflows, utilizing AWS crypto traits and Guzzle promises.

classes.name: S3EncryptionClient
classes.description: A client class that extends AbstractCryptoClient to facilitate encryption and decryption of objects stored in S3, providing methods for asynchronous and synchronous operations with integrated cryptographic workflows.

methods.name: putObject
methods.description: Encrypts and uploads an object to S3 synchronously.

methods.name: putObjectAsync
methods.description: Encrypts and uploads an object to S3 asynchronously, returning a promise.

methods.name: getObject
methods.description: Retrieves and decrypts an object from S3 synchronously.

methods.name: getObjectAsync
methods.description: Retrieves and decrypts an object from S3 asynchronously, returning a promise.
